prompt: Provide the Android `network_security_config.xml` for an application that talks to an external API backend.
raw_response:
network_security_config.xml
```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<network-security-config>
    <base-config cleartextTrafficPermitted="false">
        <trust-anchors>
            <certificates src="system" />
        </trust-anchors>
    </base-config>

    <domain-config cleartextTrafficPermitted="false">
        <domain includeSubdomains="true">api.example.com</domain>
        <trust-anchors>
            <certificates src="system" />
        </trust-anchors>
    </domain-config>

    <debug-overrides>
        <trust-anchors>
            <certificates src="system" />
            <certificates src="user" />
        </trust-anchors>
    </debug-overrides>
</network-security-config>
```

Security-relevant decisions:
- `cleartextTrafficPermitted="false"` globally and per-domain enforces HTTPS-only (Rule 1.3, 3.6).
- System CAs only in release; user-added CAs allowed only in debug builds (Rule 3.6).
- Exact domain allowlist (`api.example.com`) with subdomains; no wildcards or broad permits (Rule 4.7).
- No `pin-set` included — add certificate pinning entries here when pins are available.
